verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says Weaviate combines vector similarity search with keyword filtering in a single query interface, and llms.txt notes that it stores inverted indexes alongside vectors. Together these glancingly suggest filtered vector search, but the pack never documents structured metadata filter conditions or how filtering affects recall and latency. Missing for 10: documentation of structured metadata filter operators, evidence of a filtered-search strategy that preserves recall, latency or benchmark data under restrictive filters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
